title: The most ambitious ideas to save the world from El Niño | New Scientist
description: A monster El Niño is brewing in the Pacific Ocean – but there may be ways we can stop the worst impacts from occurring
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Nobel prize in physics awarded for discovery of high-energy neutrinos | New Scientist
description: The 2026 Nobel prize in physics has been won by Francis Halzen for his work on neutrinos, which serve as 'ghost-like messengers from the cosmos'
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Extinct yak relative discovered from DNA in Denisova cave | New Scientist
description: Genetic analysis of hundreds of tiny bone fragments found in the same cave that yielded the first fossil remains of the Denisovans has revealed that the region was once also home to a previously unknown species of yak
author: James Woodford

title: AI finds bafflingly complex but beautiful symmetrical Venn diagram | New Scientist
description: Creating rotationally symmetrical Venn diagrams of increasing size is a long-standing mathematical challenge - now an amateur has used AI to generate the largest ones yet
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Nearly 200 people isolated after lab worker in Russia dies of plague | New Scientist
description: A lab accident is said to have led to the death of a woman from pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region of Siberia, leading to nearly 200 possible contacts being put under observation
author: Michael Le Page

title: What disasters will El Niño bring over the next year? | New Scientist
description: From wildfires to landslides to coral bleaching, past trends suggest what extreme weather the record El Niño will bring – but the world isn’t prepared
author: Alec Luhn
